title: HB 574 (114th General Assembly): AN ACT to amend Tennessee Code Annotated, Title 2, relative to voter identification.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) Sec 1, new 2-7-112(c)(2) (existing law keeps (c)(1) accepted-ID list)
(quote) "Evidence of identification," as described in subdivision (c)(1), does not include a license, identification card, passport, or other document that has expired or that is invalid for any reason.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule)
(section) Sec 2, new 2-2 section (no registration without valid unexpired ID)
(quote) a county election commission shall not register a person to vote unless the applicant has provided proof satisfactory to the respective commission that the person holds valid, unexpired evidence of identification as described in § 2-7-112(c)(1) at the time of processing the applicant's application to register.
(other) Sec 1 also designates existing 2-7-112(c) as (c)(1) (accepted-ID list unchanged).
(other) Sec 3: effective on becoming law.
(other) version: 3090275-Draft (2025-01-29): both operative sections as above (slots a and e).
(other) version: 3094839-Draft (2025-01-31): same words; header adds companion Senate Bill 658 (Hensley).
(other) note: Introduced only. Last real action 2025-02-18: taken off notice in the House Elections & Campaign Finance Subcommittee. No roll calls. Sec 2 would apply a valid-ID test to the registration step (a registration rule), separate from voting.
